messages:
maria-cs: FYI — CryptoHealth just sent a vendor security questionnaire as part of their onboarding. They flagged: EU data residency (Frankfurt), signed DPA with EU addendum, HSM-backed key ownership, SOC2 evidence, SSO + SCIM, and an on‑prem option for clinical trial data. Link to form: https://vendorforms.cryptohealth.example/form/abc123 

oliver-security: quick skim — main technical asks: 
1) They want keys in an HSM that they control (i.e., key never leaves their HSM).
2) Nightly replication in DE + proof of residency.
3) SOC2 scope must include inference runtime and infra where keys are used.
We can provide SOC2 Type 2 + attestation, but HSM-level customer control only available with Private (on‑prem) or a Dedicated configuration with customer HSM appliances.

jess-legal: We can offer a DPA + EU addendum. For HSM / BYOK language we need to clarify: customer-managed keys (BYOK) via cloud KMS is different from customer HSM appliances. Suggest we propose two tracks: 1) VPC/Dedicated with BYOK (KMS) + SOC2 docs; 2) On‑prem Private deployment for full HSM custody. I'll prepare a DPA redline template.

dave-platops: Timeline/ops notes: 
- VPC + BYOK (AWS KMS/GCP KMS) — ~2–3 weeks to configure and test once legal + permissions are in place.
- Dedicated with HSM appliances — depends on procurement; assume 6–10 weeks.
- On‑prem package (air‑gapped) — 8–12 weeks including infra validation and runbook.
We can also provision a Frankfurt-only tenancy for hosted customers if they accept our regional tenancy model; need capacity check.

maria-cs: Action items I propose: 
1) Ask CryptoHealth: do they require hardware HSM (FIPS 140‑2 level) or is BYOK via cloud KMS acceptable?
2) Ask whether VPC (EU-only) would satisfy residency or if physical on‑prem is mandatory.
3) Request POC data size and timing for compliance review.
I'll draft an initial response; need SOC2 + DPA bits from you all. :eyes: 

simon-ct: Thanks for the quick turnaround. For regulatory reasons we prefer HSM-backed keys where we have attestable control. BYOK via cloud KMS is acceptable if we get attestation that key material never leaves our HSM and that audit logs are available for 7 years. On‑prem is preferred for the trial, but if VPC+HSM attestation is possible, we can proceed faster. Also can you provide a redacted SOC2 report?

oliver-security: We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type 2 report and a short security attestation letter covering inference runtime. For BYOK: we support AWS KMS and GCP CMEK integrations; those do not meet the same guarantees as a dedicated HSM appliance. If they need HSM-level guarantee (FIPS 140‑2 hardware key custody), that requires Private or Dedicated+HSM. Audit log retention 7 years — we can retain logs for that long for Dedicated/Private customers; hosted tier may need an add‑on.

jess-legal: Pasting a proposed DPA snippet for the EU addendum we can start with (will redline formally):

```
Data Residency Addendum:
Vendor agrees to process and store Personal Data originating from Customer in data centers physically located within the European Union (DE). Subprocessors with access to such Personal Data shall only operate within the EU unless Customer provides prior written consent.
Customer-managed Key Clause:
Vendor shall support Customer-controlled key management (BYOK). Hardware-backed key custody (HSM) shall be provided only under Dedicated or Private deployment options; for cloud KMS integrations, Vendor shall provide technical attestation and audit logs demonstrating that key material is not exported.
Retention and Logs:
Vendor will retain system and access logs relevant to Customer data for a period of 7 years in an EU jurisdiction for Dedicated/Private deployments.
```

jess-legal: I'll attach the full DPA template in the next message once legal has redlined.

deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-3147: cryptohealth-onboard-security-ops. Assignee: maria-cs.

maria-cs: Assigning owners: @oliver-security for SOC2 + attestation, @dave-platops for infra timeline & POC plan, @jess-legal for DPA redline. I'll send a proposal to CryptoHealth tomorrow with two tracks (VPC+BYOK vs On‑prem) and ask for their preference. :thumbsup:

simon-ct: Appreciated — please include an estimated cost delta between VPC+BYOK and On‑prem in the proposal. We need that for our procurement team.

maria-cs: noted — will include rough cost bands. If anyone has quick numbers for delta (ops + infra lift) please post here.

oliver-security: ballpark: VPC+BYOK add‑on ~ +15–25% of hosted rates for audit + retention. On‑prem/Private — contractual setup + support bump ~ +60–90% depending on hardware. I will scope more precisely in the ticket.

maria-cs: great, thanks. Closing for now — will update thread after legal redline.
